title: SplitMergePlan
description: How source segments are split into destination-tagged subsegments and merged into the post-removal target segments. Invariants (size conservation, target balance, and the destination rule B = S~_j \ S_i) are enforced by verifyPlan in verifier.mjs against the initial and target placements.

pieces.description: Subsegments. A piece is a part of source segment `source`, of `size` units, that must be delivered to the nodes in `dest`. A whole passthrough segment is a single piece (its dest may be empty if it need not move).

id.description: Unique piece label, e.g. 'W8_6' for W_8^{6}.

source.description: Source segment id this piece is carved from.

dest.description: B: target-storage nodes that must receive this piece. Empty means no movement. Must equal S~_j \ S_source for the target j it merges into.

merges.description: Each target segment is the concatenation of its parts.

target.description: Target segment id in the target placement.

parts.description: Piece ids composing this target segment. Each piece must be consumed by exactly one merge.
